datasets.name: f05562ff
queryLines:
WITH a AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_chargeback_by_allocation_tag t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')))
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(net_list_cost_usd) FROM a WHERE is_missing_allocation_key), 0) * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS value,
       concat(CAST(ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE((SELECT SUM(net_list_cost_usd) FROM a WHERE is_missing_allocation_key), 0)
                    / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(net_list_cost_usd) FROM a), 0), 0) AS STRING),
              '% of priced spend; worst: ',
              COALESCE((SELECT nm_workspace FROM a WHERE is_missing_allocation_key ORDER BY net_list_cost_usd DESC LIMIT 1), 'none')) AS target

queryLines:
WITH u AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_unnamed_workspaces t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')))
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u WHERE status = 'CRITICAL') AS value,
       COALESCE((SELECT concat('Worst: workspace ', CAST(workspace_id AS STRING), ', $', CAST(ROUND(net_list_cost_usd * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS STRING))

datasets.name: 69efbf7f
queryLines:
WITH keys AS (
  SELECT 1 AS key_num, trim(try_element_at(split(tag_keys, ','), 1)) AS raw_key FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_info
  UNION ALL SELECT 2, trim(try_element_at(split(tag_keys, ','), 2)) FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_info
  UNION ALL SELECT 3, trim(try_element_at(split(tag_keys, ','), 3)) FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_info
),
nk AS (
  SELECT key_num, raw_key, lower(regexp_replace(raw_key, '[ _-]', '')) AS norm_key
  FROM keys WHERE raw_key IS NOT NULL AND raw_key <> ''
),
v AS (
  SELECT t.*, lower(regexp_replace(t.tag_key, '[ _-]', '')) AS norm_tag_key
  FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_chargeback_by_tag_value t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) t
  WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))
),
agg AS (
  SELECT nk.raw_key,
         SUM(CASE WHEN v.is_untagged THEN v.usd_list ELSE 0 END) AS untagged_usd,
         SUM(v.usd_list) AS total_usd
  FROM nk LEFT JOIN v ON v.norm_tag_key = nk.norm_key
  WHERE nk.key_num = 1
  GROUP BY nk.raw_key
)
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT untagged_usd FROM agg), 0) * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS value,
       COALESCE((SELECT concat(raw_key, ': ',
                 CAST(COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(untagged_usd, 0) / NULLIF(total_usd, 0), 0), 0) AS STRING),
                 '% of spend untagged')
                 FROM agg),
                 'No tag key configured at position 1') AS target

datasets.name: 822953cc
datasets.displayName: mandatory:Spend by tag value, per key
queryLines:
WITH q AS (
WITH keys AS (
  SELECT 1 AS key_num, trim(try_element_at(split(tag_keys, ','), 1)) AS raw_key FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_info
  UNION ALL SELECT 2, trim(try_element_at(split(tag_keys, ','), 2)) FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_info
  UNION ALL SELECT 3, trim(try_element_at(split(tag_keys, ','), 3)) FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_info
),
nk AS (
  SELECT key_num, raw_key, lower(regexp_replace(raw_key, '[ _-]', '')) AS norm_key
  FROM keys WHERE raw_key IS NOT NULL AND raw_key <> ''
),
v AS (
  SELECT t.*, lower(regexp_replace(t.tag_key, '[ _-]', '')) AS norm_tag_key
  FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_chargeback_by_tag_value t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) t
  WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')) AND NOT t.is_untagged
),
matched AS (
  SELECT nk.raw_key AS tag_key, COALESCE(v.tag_value, '(other)') AS value_label, SUM(v.usd_list) AS usd
  FROM nk JOIN v ON v.norm_tag_key = nk.norm_key
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT tag_key, value_label, ROUND(usd * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS usd
FROM matched
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tag_key ORDER BY usd DESC) <= 6
),
r AS (SELECT `tag_key` AS s, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(`usd`) DESC) AS rk FROM q WHERE `tag_key` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `tag_key`),
n AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM r)
SELECT q.`value_label`, q.`usd`,
       CASE WHEN q.`tag_key` IS NULL OR r.rk < 8 OR n.n <= 8 THEN CAST(q.`tag_key` AS STRING) ELSE 'Other' END AS `tag_key`
FROM q LEFT JOIN r ON r.s = q.`tag_key` CROSS JOIN n

datasets.name: 96a4e1f5
datasets.displayName: mandatory:Workspaces missing from the account's list
queryLines:
SELECT status, CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace, date_format(first_used, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS first_used,
       date_format(last_used, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS last_used, active_days, dbus_365d,
       ROUND(net_list_cost_usd * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS usd_window, ROUND(net_list_cost_usd_365d * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS usd_365d
FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_unnamed_workspaces t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))
WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))
ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'WARN' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, net_list_cost_usd DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 200

datasets.name: 4c418ba1
datasets.displayName: mandatory:Spend with no cost-center tag, worst rows
queryLines:
SELECT status, nm_workspace AS workspace, usage_unit, ROUND(net_usage_quantity, 2) AS net_usage_quantity,
       ROUND(net_list_cost_usd * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS usd, share_of_unit_pct
FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_chargeback_by_allocation_tag t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))
WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')) AND is_missing_allocation_key AND status IN ('CRITICAL', 'WARN')
ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, net_list_cost_usd DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 200

datasets.name: b72ef127
queryLines:
SELECT c.title AS check_title,
       c.page AS page,
       CASE WHEN l.query_id IS NULL THEN 'Not run'
            WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 'Warn'
            WHEN l.has_status THEN 'OK'
            WHEN l.row_count = 0 THEN 'No rows'
            ELSE 'Listed' END AS verdict,
       l.row_count AS row_count,
       l.critical AS critical_rows,
       l.warn AS warn_rows,
       l.error AS error
FROM (VALUES
       (0, 'cost_chargeback_by_tag', 'Spend by cost center or team', 'Tags'),
       (1, 'cost_chargeback_by_allocation_tag', 'Spend with no cost center or team tag', 'Tags'),
       (2, 'cost_chargeback_by_tag_value', 'Chargeback by tag value', 'Tags'),
       (3, 'cost_usage_policy_coverage', 'Serverless usage without a policy', 'Tags'),
       (4, 'cost_unnamed_workspaces', 'Spend on workspaces with no name', 'Tags')) AS c(ord, query_id, title, page)
LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_log l ON l.query_id = c.query_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 0 WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 1 WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, c.ord

datasets.name: 1a1bd1a1
queryLines:
SELECT
  COALESCE(concat(n_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), NULL) AS `workspace_shown`,
  CAST(t.`usage_date` AS STRING) AS `usage_date`,
  t.`cloud` AS `cloud`,
  t.`billing_origin_product` AS `billing_origin_product`,
  t.`tag_key` AS `tag_key`,
  t.`tag_value` AS `tag_value`,
  t.`net_usage_quantity` AS `net_usage_quantity`,
  t.`record_count` AS `record_count`
FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_chargeback_by_tag t
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) n_workspace
  ON n_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)
WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(n_workspace.n, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))
ORDER BY `usage_date` DESC NULLS LAST, `tag_key` ASC NULLS LAST, `tag_value` ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5000

datasets.name: b110cf5e
queryLines:
SELECT
  COALESCE(concat(n_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), NULL) AS `workspace_shown`,
  t.`status` AS `status`,
  t.`usage_unit` AS `usage_unit`,
  t.`allocation_key` AS `allocation_key`,

  t.`net_usage_quantity` AS `net_usage_quantity`,
  t.`net_list_cost_usd` AS `net_list_cost_usd`,
  t.`share_of_unit_pct` AS `share_of_unit_pct`,
  t.`price_basis` AS `price_basis`,
  t.`not_assessed_reason` AS `not_assessed_reason`
FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_chargeback_by_allocation_tag t
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) n_workspace
